meta.name: encyclopedia-writing
meta.description: Encyclopedic neutral-reference writing craft — NPOV (attribute facts not opinions, due weight, neutral faction labels, verdict restraint), summary style and Coatrack avoidance, wikilink conventions (link density, first-mention, slug alias, abbreviation glossing). Use when writing or reviewing a neutral encyclopedic/wiki reference, landscape overview, hub, or source page, or when a source-based connected document that advocates no particular viewpoint is needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写符合中立原则的百科式参考内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要撰写或审阅不偏不倚的百科式参考文档。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write or review neutral encyclopedic reference documents.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照百科全书风格写作：用事实和来源支撑观点，避免主观评价；控制链接密度，首次出现时加链接；缩写首次出现时给出全称；保持中立，不偏向任何一方。
howto.when: 当你要求撰写或审阅百科式文章、综述、枢纽页或需要中立参考的文档时触发。

say.text: 请用百科全书风格写一篇关于量子计算的概述。
say.note: Claude 会生成中立、有来源的概述。

say.text: 帮我审阅这段文字，确保它符合中立观点。
say.note: Claude 会检查并修正主观表述。

say.text: 把这篇技术文章改写成百科条目风格。
say.note: Claude 会调整语气和结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes in an encyclopedic style: uses facts and sources to support claims, avoids subjective judgments; controls link density, links at first mention; glosses abbreviations on first use; maintains neutrality without favoring any side.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write or review an encyclopedic article, landscape overview, hub page, or any document requiring neutral reference.

say_en.text: Write an encyclopedic overview of quantum computing.
say_en.note: Claude generates a neutral, sourced overview.

say_en.text: Review this text for NPOV compliance.
say_en.note: Claude checks and fixes subjective statements.

say_en.text: Rewrite this technical article as an encyclopedia entry.
